# Browser Error Log

Self-hostable browser error collection. Read the installed package version and declarations before integration.

- [AI integration guide](docs/ai.md): local skill setup and evidence locations.
- [Portable integration skill](skills/browser-error-log/SKILL.md): browser, React and collector workflows.
- [Browser integration reference](skills/browser-error-log/references/integration.md): presets, lifecycle and verification.
- [Collector contract](skills/browser-error-log/references/collector.md): batch acknowledgement and protocol boundaries.
- [Preset performance report](docs/preset-performance-2026-11-17.ko.md): synthetic 0.2.13 CPU, heap, RSS and payload measurements.
